open_points.subject: store_image
open_points.text: - store_image: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST build the reference as a relative Portal file reference of three segments, the imported STORED_IMAGES_FOLDER constant, the canonical lowercase hyphenated project id and the source id followed by the imported STORED_IMAGE_SUFFIX constant, take its path from _store_path before anything is written, write content there with _atomic_write below the resolved binary_root of context with the imported STORED_IMAGE_MODE constant, the imported STORE_FOLDER_MODE constant for folders and durable_folder true, and return the reference; a DelivererError of _store_path and an OSError of the write MUST pass to the caller.
open_points.other_text: def store_image(context: DeliveryContext, project_id: UUID, source_id: str, content: bytes) -> str
open_points.question: Either constrain or validate source_id so it cannot contain path separators, or remove the requirement that the resulting reference always has exactly three segments.
